DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis

The symptom of a chronic cough producing copious amounts of thick, foamy, yellow-green sputum for 11 years in a non-smoker is highly suggestive of bronchiectasis. While I have requested the sputum culture and chest X-ray to confirm the findings and rule out other causes like lung abscess or tuberculosis, the clinical presentation of recurrent infections with purulent sputum is the key indicator here.
